mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) falls by more than 2% over 6 months, it signals a supply-side contraction that will reduce corporate profits and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls > 2% in 6 months, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will increase borrowing costs and reduce investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% over 6 months, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% in 6 months, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will increase wage pressures and reduce corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening credit cycle that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth > 10%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% over 6 months, it signals a rising inflationary environment that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 3% in 6 months, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.
